turns.assessment: The simultaneous ~5.2 dB reduction at both input and output of every amplifier on S18→S19 localizes the loss ahead of the booster, while the incoming channel at S18 from S24 is unchanged. Stable pump currents and preserved amplifier gain rule out an amplifier fault. The best match is contamination of the S18 outgoing OMS input patch toward S19, reducing all optical power through that section and degrading OSNR at S19 and S10.

proposals.rationale: A dirty patch between the S18 ROADM degree and the S18→S19 booster would lower amp0 input and consequently every downstream amplifier input/output by the observed similar amount. The unaffected S24→S18 monitoring places the loss after arrival at S18.
